const expData = [
    {
        id: "1",
        org: "TechCorp Solutions",
        title: "Full Stack Developer",
        date: "Jan 2023 - Present",
        location: "Bangalore, India",
        type: "Full-time",
        description: "Leading development of scalable web applications and microservices architecture serving thousands of users daily.",
        responsibilities: [
            "Led development of microservices architecture serving 10,000+ daily active users",
            "Implemented CI/CD pipelines reducing deployment time by 60%",
            "Collaborated with cross-functional teams to deliver 15+ successful projects",
            "Mentored 3 junior developers and conducted code reviews"
        ],
        achievements: [
            "Improved application performance by 45%",
            "Reduced server costs by 30% through optimization",
            "Achieved 99.9% uptime for critical services"
        ],
        technologies: ["React", "Node.js", "MongoDB", "AWS", "Docker", "Kubernetes"]
    },
    {
        id: "2",
        org: "Digital Innovations Ltd",
        title: "Frontend Developer",
        date: "Jun 2022 - Dec 2022",
        location: "Mumbai, India",
        type: "Full-time",
        description: "Developed responsive web applications and collaborated with design teams to create exceptional user experiences.",
        responsibilities: [
            "Developed responsive web applications using React.js and TypeScript",
            "Collaborated with UX/UI designers to implement pixel-perfect designs",
            "Optimized web applications for maximum speed and scalability",
            "Integrated RESTful APIs and managed state using Redux"
        ],
        achievements: [
            "Increased user engagement by 25%",
            "Reduced page load time by 50%",
            "Successfully delivered 8 client projects"
        ],
        technologies: ["React", "TypeScript", "Redux", "Tailwind CSS", "Next.js"]
    },
    {
        id: "1",
        org: "BOCK Chain",
        title: "Software Engineer Intern",
        date: "Nov 2024 - Feb 2025",
        location: "Remote",
        type: "Internship",
        description: "Currently designing user interfaces and implementing backend services for blockchain-based applications.",
        responsibilities: [
            "Designing intuitive user interfaces for blockchain applications",
            "Implementing secure backend services for user authentication",
            "Developing file management systems with encryption",
            "Collaborating with blockchain developers on smart contract integration"
        ],
        achievements: [
            "Successfully integrated Web3 wallet connectivity",
            "Improved user onboarding flow by 40%",
            "Contributed to 3 major feature releases"
        ],
        technologies: ["React", "Web3.js", "Node.js", "Solidity", "MongoDB"]
    },
    {
        id: "4",
        org: "BSQ Technology",
        title: "Web Developer Intern",
        date: "June 2023 - Aug 2023",
        location: "Hybrid",
        type: "Internship",
        description: "Designed user interfaces and implemented backend services for property management applications.",
        responsibilities: [
            "Designed responsive user interfaces for property management platform",
            "Implemented secure user authentication and authorization systems",
            "Developed property management features including listings and search",
            "Ensured responsive design across all device types"
        ],
        achievements: [
            "Delivered project 2 weeks ahead of schedule",
            "Received excellent feedback from supervisors",
            "Contributed to 20% increase in user registrations"
        ],
        technologies: ["HTML5", "CSS3", "JavaScript", "PHP", "MySQL"]
    }
];

export default expData;
